blocks.x: But who had the straight bands, you know, straight reading bands other than.
Well Robichaud and Tuxedo did a lot of reading. But after that, them other fellows, they weren't doing much reading. This Desveen fellow too, he had a nice reading band.
And those guys, would they play any jazz at all?

Yeah, they play jazz, but it wasn't the hardest to hit musicians, you know. Yeah. It looked like they had something in them, they'd just take it all, take all, all that stuff out, that music stuff, they'd just knock that out. No fire.
